description: Field Core Web Vitals of the property's origin (or a URL) from the Chrome UX Report history, weekly, per form factor (PHONE, DESKTOP): latest p75 of LCP, INP, CLS, FCP, TTFB with rating (good / needs_improvement / poor by Google's thresholds), share of good experiences, trend vs 4 weeks earlier, passesCoreWebVitals, alerts when a metric changed rating or worsened >= 20 %, and up to 26 weeks of history. CrUX only exists for origins with enough Chrome traffic; the response lists what is available. Use for "is the site fast enough for Google", regressions after a release, mobile vs desktop. / Core Web Vitals reais (CrUX) por semana e dispositivo, com tendência e alertas.

originOrUrl.description: Origin or URL as stored (default: all targets of the property).

site.description: Property: displayName ("example.com"), Search Console siteUrl ("sc-domain:example.com", "https://www.example.com/") or numeric id. A unique substring among visible properties also works ("exam"). list_sites shows the options. The value "demo" selects a demonstration site with fictional data: it works without signing in and is read-only. / Propriedade por nome, siteUrl ou id; "demo" é um site de demonstração com dados fictícios, sem login e só leitura.
